appDescription.message: Find Gmail and Yandex email codes and fill OTP fields with one click. Optional Cloud IMAP without installing programs.

tagline.message: Your email codes, exactly where you need them.

desc2fa.message: This field needs a code from an authenticator app.

descSms.message: This field needs a text-message code.

descEmail.message: A matching email code can appear beside the field.

descUnknown.message: Check the requested code source before using Gmail.

descManual.message: No code field yet. You can still search Gmail.

codeInserted.message: Code inserted. Finish on the website.

codeCopied.message: Code copied. Paste it into the website.

connectPrompt.message: Connect a mail account to find your codes.

privacyDisclaimer.message: Gmail connects directly to Google. Optional CodeSnap Cloud processes recent IMAP mail and stores credentials encrypted on our server. No sending or deleting emails.

autoAppear.message: Appear automatically. Tap the code to insert it.

proNote.message: Pro features are unlocked in this test build. Payments are not available yet.

footerTrust.message: CodeSnap never submits the website form for you.

detailedPopupDescription.message: Show code, sender, account and time beside the field.

inlineReview.message: Check sender and subject before inserting

mailCloudDescription.message: Yandex, Mail.ru, Yahoo and IMAP without installing programs. Gmail connects directly.

mailCloudStorage.message: App passwords and OAuth tokens are encrypted on the CodeSnap server. Mail is processed in memory, not saved to disk. Turning Cloud off pauses access; remove each account first to delete its stored credentials.

mailCloudConsent.message: Allow the CodeSnap server to store connection credentials encrypted and read recent emails to find codes. Removing the account deletes its connection credentials from the server.

mailCloudEnableFirst.message: Enable Mail through CodeSnap Cloud in Settings below, then confirm the connection in the form.

mailCloudConsentRequired.message: Check the consent box to allow the CodeSnap server to read recent emails.

yandexOAuthHint.message: Sign in on the official Yandex website. Our server reads mail through IMAP because Chrome cannot connect to IMAP directly. No software installation is needed.
